description: This file defines a PHP trait 'SessionConnectionConfigTrait' used for configuring session storage in AWS DynamoDb. It contains properties and methods to set and get configuration parameters related to session storage, such as table name, hash key, session lifetime, locking, and retry timings. It also includes a method to initialize configuration from an array, transforming underscore-separated keys to camelCase method calls.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration properties from an provided associative array, calling corresponding setter methods, transforming underscore keys to camelCase method names, and defaulting session lifetime if not provided.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the DynamoDb table used to store sessions.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the DynamoDb table name used for session storage.

methods.name: getHashKey
methods.description: Returns the name of the hash key in the DynamoDb table.

methods.name: setHashKey
methods.description: Sets the hash key name in the DynamoDb table.

methods.name: getDataAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute name used for session data in the table.

methods.name: setDataAttribute
methods.description: Sets the attribute name used for session data.

methods.name: getDataAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the attribute used for session data.

methods.name: setDataAttributeType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the session data attribute.

methods.name: getSessionLifetime
methods.description: Returns the session lifetime setting.

methods.name: setSessionLifetime
methods.description: Sets the session lifetime value.

methods.name: getSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute name for session lifetime expiration.

methods.name: setSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Sets the attribute name for session lifetime expiration.

methods.name: isConsistentRead
methods.description: Indicates whether consistent reads are used.

methods.name: setConsistentRead
methods.description: Sets whether to use consistent reads.

methods.name: getBatchConfig
methods.description: Returns the batch configuration used for garbage collection.

methods.name: setBatchConfig
methods.description: Sets the batch configuration for garbage collection.

methods.name: isLocking
methods.description: Indicates whether session locking is enabled.

methods.name: setLocking
methods.description: Enables or disables session locking.

methods.name: getMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum lock wait time in seconds.

methods.name: setMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum time to wait for lock acquisition.

methods.name: getMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns the minimum microsecond delay between lock retries.

methods.name: setMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets the minimum microsecond delay between lock retries.

methods.name: getMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns the maximum microsecond delay between lock retries.

methods.name: setMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets the maximum microsecond delay between lock retries.
